t: For an additional amount for “Military Personnel, Marine Corps”, $1,826,688,000.

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation of funds for Marine Corps military personnel. Nothing in it tempts a participation reading: it names no outside party, no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, so no one outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Military Personnel, Marine Corps”, $1,826,688,000.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation of funds for military personnel. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Military Personnel, Marine Corps”, $1,826,688,000.

opus.w: This section only appropriates extra money for Marine Corps military personnel. It does not ask the federal government to consult or coordinate with anyone outside it before deciding something. There is also no comment period, hearing, advisory committee, rulemaking authority, or right to sue, so there is no reading on which this counts as participation.
opus.s: For an additional amount for “Military Personnel, Marine Corps”, $1,826,688,000.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a simple appropriation of funds for military personnel salaries and benefits. It does not describe any process of consultation, coordination, or decision-making involving parties outside the federal government. Marine Corps personnel are federal employees, so their involvement does not constitute participation under the definition.
qwen_chat.s: For an additional amount for “Military Personnel, Marine Corps”, $1,826,688,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "Military Personnel" implies the involvement of people, and thus participation. However, this is merely an appropriation for salaries and benefits for federal employees (Marine Corps members), who are inside the federal government. There is no consultation, coordination, or decision-making process involving outside parties described in this text.
